name: Martsirt: coast exit moves off the centre line to the SW trail
apply: Edit martsirt_world.json exits[to=coast] and arrive.coast as below; append roads_add to placements.json header.v2.roads; add the road class to models/town/ground_v1/manifest.json road_classes; swap martsirt_splat.png for martsirt_splat_v2.png (same size/format, r channel = trail). Border: use borders/martsirt/layout_martsirt_v2.json (pass12 moved to the new exit). Seam: seams/coast__martsirt_v2.json. Idempotent: match exits by to=="coast".
schema: live martsirt_world.json exits:[{x,y,to,sx,sy,label}], arrive:{zone:[x,y]} (tile metres = town-local + origin)
requires: coast_exits_patch.json (the coast side moves to x=12.5 on its N edge in the same release)

exits_set.why: Leaving town you still walk out through the south gatehouse (the "ACT I" gate keeps its label and its camp), but the road no longer runs dead-straight down the centre line to the map edge: a dirt trail bears west under the palisade to the SW corner, which is where the coast road climbs in (continent: the coast lies south-west). The gate camp east of the gate stays a stop on the way, not a wall in the way.

coast.why: arrive on the trail 4 m inside the exit, facing east along the palisade toward the gate (Ilyra stays at the gate, 84,136)

roads_add.label: coast trail: south gate - SW to the coast road
roads_add.note: exits_v2: leaves the gatehouse mouth, bears west under the palisade (3+ m off the wall, 3+ m off the map edge) and meets the S edge at x=49.6 where the coast road arrives

splat.rule: r = max(r, trail); g,b scaled down only where r+g+b>1; cobble (g>=0.5, the gate mouth) untouched

solid_note: trail runs on open ground; no solid or water bit changes
props_note: no placements move. dressLife gate camp (campfire 84.2,150.6, fence 86,150.8, crates/barrels) is east of the trail; nearest 3.6 m

north_exit.why: north gap west of the watch-house already sits off-centre (76.2 of 162) and the north high road bends into it; it reads naturally

alternative_B.idea: a west postern at the end of the mill lane (local -50.9,27.4), out through the west palisade, then a trail south to the SW corner
alternative_B.cost: needs one palisade segment removed/turned into a postern (placements change) and a 50 m trail; the gate story ("ACT I") would move off the gatehouse
alternative_B.why_not: more invasive than needed; the south gate is the town's front door

continent_note: continent_layout places coast flush S of Martsirt with exits coinciding: coast x0 shifts from 60.8 to 37.1 (Martsirt frame); still clear of all other rects (see EXITS.md)
